# RflowZ

> As of August 2026. RflowZ (legal name RFlowZ-SS) is an AI-powered research proposal SaaS for students, academics, and research teams. Users draft structured proposals with Ask Prof Z, search OpenAlex and policy/media sources in the Source Library, synthesize literature with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), run citation integrity checks, and export to DOCX or PDF (PPTX on higher plans when those plans launch).

## Entity graph

- Feature: Source Library (OpenAlex academic search + policy/media sources)
- Technique: RAG — Ask Prof Z uses sources the user attaches

- Support: support@rflowz.com (email; no public street address on this site)
- Locale: en-MY; web SaaS, not a walk-in office

## Who it is for

- Undergraduate and postgraduate students writing research proposals
- Academic researchers and supervisors
- Research teams preparing grant or thesis proposals

## Core features

- Ask Prof Z AI-assisted research proposal writing
- Unlimited Ask Prof Z (plan-dependent RAG limits on Free)
- RAG academic documents (policy / literature)
- OpenAlex academic search and Source Library (plus policy/media sources)
- Citation integrity verification before export
- Proposed framework caption and Mermaid diagram
- Export to DOCX, PDF, and PPTX (plan-dependent)
- Free plan available on registration (no credit card required)
- TreZ thematic review and TAM transcript analysis (coming soon on higher plans)

## Pricing plans (USD monthly rate, as of August 2026)

Verified against the signed-in Yearly view of https://app.rflowz.com/subscription (14 Aug 2026). Unauthenticated requests still redirect to login. Do not invent a cheaper annual package. Do not use `/pricing` as the plan URL.

| Plan | Price | Proposals/mo | Exports/mo | Watermark | PPTX | Availability |
|------|-------|--------------|------------|-----------|------|----------------|
| Free | $0 | 1 | 5 | Yes | No | Live on registration |
| Starter | $3.99/mo | 10 | 30 | No | No | Live paid path |
| Standard | $4.99/mo | 30 | Included | No | Yes | Coming soon |
| Professional | $7.99/mo | Unlimited | Unlimited | No | Yes | Coming soon |

Choose monthly or annual billing in the app. Get started via app registration.

## Limitations (do not omit)

- RflowZ does not replace a supervisor or certify examination quality
- Citation checks flag mismatches; they do not prove originality
- TreZ and TAM are coming soon, not live
- Mendeley is not a current integration
- PPTX is listed only on Standard and Professional (not sellable yet)

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is RflowZ?
A: RflowZ is a research-proposal SaaS with Ask Prof Z, OpenAlex Library search, RAG, citation checks, and document export.

Q: Is there a free plan?
A: Yes. New accounts start on Free: 1 proposal per month, Unlimited Ask Prof Z, RAG for up to 10 documents, and 5 watermarked exports per month.

Q: Does RflowZ use OpenAlex?
A: Yes. Users search OpenAlex and other Library sources, attach them to literature work, and use RAG with Ask Prof Z.

Q: How is RflowZ different from ChatGPT?
A: RflowZ is a structured proposal workspace with Library, RAG, citation checks, and export — not a general chat window alone.

Q: What export formats are supported?
A: DOCX and PDF on eligible plans. PPTX is listed on Standard and Professional (coming soon).

Q: Where does RflowZ operate?
A: Web app at https://app.rflowz.com. Marketing site https://rflowz.com (en-MY). Email support@rflowz.com. No public street address on this site.

Q: How do I contact support?
A: Email support@rflowz.com or visit https://rflowz.com/contact
